_about: Fixture F (PLAN-conditions-every-bot §4.1): money values computed by hand, never by the code under test. Each case states its inputs and the arithmetic in `why`. Minimums are quote minimums (Alpaca sizes in quote); every leg's base is above the base minimum.

index_cap_one.why: Index top 3 by cap 5/3/2 of 10 -> weights 0.5/0.3/0.2, empty holdings. quote_amount 60, one interval owed: pending 60. Cap 1 enabled before any buy: remainder 1 - 0 = 1, binding (1 <= 60). Split 1 x 0.5/0.3/0.2 = 0.5/0.3/0.2, each under the 1 USD minimum: no leg placeable -> stop.

index_carry_cap.why: Codex counterexample. Weekly, started 2026-08-25 14:00; an after-latched price rule met 2026-09-01 13:00, so the window opens at 13:00; tick at 2026-09-01 14:00:00.5, last checkpoint 14:00 -> one interval. carry 20 + 10 x 1 - 0 spent in the window = 30 owed. Cap 100 enabled 2026-08-01; a 95 USD buy on 2026-08-28 (before the window, after the cap's start) counts toward the cap only: remainder 100 - 95 = 5. Total = min(30, 5) = 5.

i_under_every_minimum.why: 3 members at 0.5/0.3/0.2, empty holdings, quote_amount 60 (pending 60). Cap 9: binding. Legs 4.5/2.7/1.8, each under the 5 USD minimum -> stop.

ii_three_by_four.why: Codex case: 3 equal weights (1/3 each as Floats; Float#to_d leaves each leg a hair under 4), cap 12 binding on pending 60. Legs 12/3 = 4 each (4.00 to the cent), all under the 5 USD minimum -> stop.

iii_one_leg_placeable.why: Weights 0.5/0.25/0.25, cap 12 binding on pending 60. Legs 6/3/3: the 6 USD leg clears the 5 USD minimum and is placed (notional 6.00); the two 3 USD legs are below the minimum and, beside a placed leg, are reported as one line with no skipped rows (Rails' record_skipped_orders!). A placeable leg: no stop.

iv_not_binding.why: quote_amount 12, cap 1000: the remainder 1000 > pending 12, so the cap does not bind. Legs 4/4/4 (equal weights) under the 5 USD minimum are skipped and stay owed; no stop.

v_boundary_above.why: One member (weight 1), cap 5.01 binding on pending 60: one leg of 5.01 = the 5 USD minimum + one cent (quote_decimals 2) -> placed, notional 5.01.

v_boundary_below.why: One member, cap 4.99 binding: one leg of 4.99, one cent under the 5 USD minimum -> stop.

vi_index_five_by_four.why: Index of 5 members with equal caps -> weights 0.2 each, empty holdings, quote_amount 60. Cap 20 binding: legs 20 x 0.2 = 4 each, all under the 5 USD minimum -> stop.
